title: Aquazone: Desktop Life Option Disc Series 1: Angel Fish
native_title: アクアゾーン・オプション・ディスク・シリーズ１ ～エンゼル・フィッシュ～
overview: Aquazone: Desktop Life Option Disc Series 1: Angel Fish is a Sega Saturn simulation game released exclusively in Japan. It is not technically a game, but rather a tropical fish simulator.
